_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::electrochemistry#4 — CALCFLUX_DOMAIN: 'total' is what puts species fluxes into the VTK output, and its absence is an absence rather than a placeholder. On upstream elch_2D_tertiary_twoEqu_ENC_varParams_ndb_2iter (which carries no CALCFLUX key) the .vtu holds phi_1..phi_4 and no flux array at all (WITHOUT_KEY_FLUX_ARRAYS=0); adding CALCFLUX_DOMAIN: 'total' to SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC adds flux_domain_phi_1..flux_domain_phi_4 (WITH_TOTAL_FLUX_ARRAYS=4). The solution is untouched — both arms pass all ten result tests — so this is an output switch, not a physics one. The entry's Signal said the flux fields 'show not computed'; that string is in neither the log nor the .vtu (CLAIMED_NOT_COMPUTED_TEXT=0), because there is no field there to say anything. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the second arm no CALCFLUX_DOMAIN either. The flux arrays never appear, WITH_TOTAL_FLUX_ARRAYS drops to 0 and the fixture must go red.
